Maya (Product): FYI — drafting the rollout plan for the 'surge-tempering' initiative. Goal: let features ramp without violating SLAs during region spikes. Need input on pacing, kill-switches, and tenant isolation.
Sam (Eng): 👍 can you call out concrete ramp steps? percentages and durations help.
Maya (Product): Proposal:
- phase 0: shadow 10% traffic (no kill, telemetry only) — 48h
- phase 1: soft-ramp 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 24h increments
- phase 2: scale to 25% with warmup windows and prefix caching enabled
- phase 3: full release with tenant quotas
Priya (SRE): Add automatic pause when p95 latency > 250ms for 5m OR error rate > 0.5% for 10m. Pause should drop new opt-ins, diffuse traffic back to baseline by routing to fallback path.
Tom (ML Eng): For model-backed routes we also need KV cache priming. Suggest: during soft-ramp we prefill KV for top 1k tenants and enable KV-only priming mode.
Ruth (Customer Success): Customers want an opt-out toggle and advance notice for their orgs. Can we expose per-tenant holdback for 7 days post-launch?
Eli (PM): Yes — include per-tenant opt-out. Also: rollout criteria checklist in the console: telemetry health (p50/p95/p99), accuracy regression < 0.5%, cost delta < 10%.
Aisha (Security): Any data plane routing changes must pass our egress review. Also confirm flag configs don't leak tenant IDs in logs.
Sam (Eng): Implementation notes: feature flag key = feature/surge-temper; config example:
```
feature: surge-temper
phases:
  - id: shadow-10
    mode: shadow
    sample: 0.10
    duration: 48h
  - id: soft-1-5-10
    mode: live
    steps: [0.01,0.05,0.10]
    step_duration: 24h
  - id: warmup-25
    mode: live
    sample: 0.25
    duration: 24h
kill_rules:
  p95_latency_ms: 250
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  cooldown: 30m
```
Priya (SRE): Add hedging rule to route a fraction (hedge_pct) of requests to a secondary region when regional CPU util > 80% to prevent tail spikes.
Tom (ML Eng): Note: hedging increases token cost. Add cost guard: if cost delta > 15% abort hedging and alert infra team.
Ruth (Customer Success): For enterprise customers on Dedicated, we should offer a scheduled maintenance window to opt into full ramp.
Eli (PM): Launch criteria (must pass all):
- Telemetry: p95 < 200ms & error_rate < 0.2% during a 4h preflight
- Regression tests: A/B eval passed (stat sig) on key prompts
- Ops readiness: rollback playbook, runbook, and 2 on-call engineers assigned
- Security & compliance signoff
Sam (Eng): Rollback playbook sketch:
1) flip feature/surge-temper -> hold
2) redirect traffic slices to baseline model variant
3) trigger KV cache invalidation and fallback warming
4) page SRE
Priya (SRE): Also add a fast manual kill: /deploybot pause-feature surge-temper --global
DeployBot: command registered: /deploybot pause-feature surge-temper executed by Priya — feature paused in 3 regions
Maya (Product): Questions: what about A/B testing? Do we combine with phased rollout or keep separate cohorts?
Eli (PM): Keep A/B as orthogonal. Use A/B cohorts nested inside phases for quality signals only. No A/B cohorts in early shadow.
Sam (Eng): Ops signal hooks we need:
- metric: p95 latency per-region
- metric: error_rate per-tenant
- metric: cost_per_1k_tokens
All hooks should support automatic rollback thresholds and slack alerts to #eng-oncall.
Aisha (Security): Also add anomaly detection for unusual token patterns to catch exfil attempts during ramp.
Ruth (Customer Success): We should prepare a short customer comms template and an opt-out FAQ.
Maya (Product): Next steps: Sam to prototype flag config and kill rules; Priya to add SLO monitors and hedging; Tom to prep KV priming tool; Ruth to draft comms. Check-in in 48h.
Sam (Eng): On it — will post PR with config and a smoke-run plan.
Priya (SRE): Will add monitoring playbook and alert routing to #eng-oncall.
Tom (ML Eng): I'll script priming run and estimate token cost.
Ruth (Customer Success): Drafts incoming.
Maya (Product): Thanks everyone. Filing this thread as reference for the launch checklist. :raised_hands:
